specs.title: Order with a card, from basket to order history

steps.title: Precondition: log in a new customer with a saved address, a saved card and an empty basket
1. Add product A two times and product B one time from the product list
2. Open the basket
3. Click "Checkout", select the saved address and continue
4. Select "One Day Delivery" and continue
5. Redeem the coupon of the current month
6. Select the saved card and continue
7. Click "Place your order and pay"
8. Read the order summary on the confirmation page
9. Read the basket counter and open the basket
10. Open "Order History" from the account menu

10. Open "Order History" from the account menu
